Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 24381 of 2024
Applicant :- Mohd Shakir

Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Udai Prakash Deo Pandey
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Arun Kumar Singh Deshwal,J.
1.
Supplementary affidavit filed today is taken on record.
2. Heard Sri Saurabh Tripathi, Advocate holding brief of Sri Udai Prakash Deo Pandey, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Ramesh Kumar, learned A.G.A for the State and perused the record.

3. The instant application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed for quashing the order dated 20.08.2022 passed by Civil Judge (S.D.)/A.C.J.M., Sonbhadra, District Sonbhadra in Case No.13 of 2021 arising out of Complaint No.2340 of 2016, under Sections 498A, 323, 504 IPC and 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act, P.S.- Pipari, District Sonbhadra on the ground of compromise.

4. Contention of learned counsel for the applicant is that as per the allegation in the impugned compliant, the applicant was middle man, who arranged the marriage between the opposite party no.2 and her husband.

It is further submitted that against the impugned proceeding husband of Mohd Shakir vs State Of U.P. And Another on 12 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/117983174/
1 opposite party no.2 had filed an Application U/S 482 No.46846 of 2023 before this Court and that matter was referred to Mediation and Conciliation Centre, High Court Allahabad vide order dated 08.01.2024.

entities.text: Mohd Shakir vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: As per the mediation report dated 19.05.2024, a settlement agreement was executed between the parties on 19.05.2024.

As per this settlement agreement, parties have decided to live separately and amount of permanent alimony of Rs.8 lakh as full and final settlement has also been paid to opposite party no.2 by way of demand draft.

Thereafter, opposite party no.2 and her husband jointly filed an application dated 21.05.2024 before the court below to terminate the proceeding of case on the basis of settlement agreed between the parties before the Mediation Centre, High Court, Allahabad.
In that application, it was specifically mentioned that now opposite party no.2 has no grievance against any of the accused including the present applicant.
This application is still pending before the court below.
It is further requested that on the basis of the aforesaid settlement, impugned proceeding may be quashed against the applicant also.

5. Per contra, learned AGA has pointed out that the applicant was not the party before the Mediation Centre, High Court Allahabad, therefore, it would be appropriate that the compromise dated 21.05.2024 may be verified by the court below, only then, the impugned proceeding may be quashed.

6. Considering the aforesaid submissions, the present application is finally disposed of with direction to the court below to verify the compromise dated 21.05.2024 after summoning the opposite party no.2 and present applicant.
After verification of the compromise, the court below will terminate the aforesaid proceeding on the basis of compromise.

7. The aforesaid proceeding shall be concluded by the court below within three months and for a period of three months, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicant in the aforesaid case.
Order Date :- 12.11.2024 A.Kr.
